# RESONANCE

RESONANCE is an evidence-first journal and executable research lab by Aleksei Safonov covering agentic AI safety, agentic payments, verification, reliability, trust infrastructure, science, technology, and human progress.

## Canonical entry points

- Publication: https://safal207.github.io/RESONANCE/
- Author: https://safal207.github.io/RESONANCE/aleksei-safonov.html
- GitHub source: https://github.com/safal207/RESONANCE
- Smart-contract QA: https://github.com/safal207/ContractGraph-QA
- AI-agent action receipts: https://github.com/safal207/T-Trace
- Pre-execution agent authorization: https://github.com/safal207/ProofPath
- Causal agent audit: https://github.com/safal207/Causal-Memory-Layer

## Editorial method

Signal → Cause → Evidence → Causality → Uncertainty → Verification → Implications → Action.

Claims should distinguish observed facts, verified results, inference, uncertainty, and explicit non-claims. GitHub repositories, executable fixtures, and CI evidence are the canonical technical sources when linked from an article.
